name: GERD (gastroesophageal reflux disease or reflux)

category.name: Abdomen and Viscera
category.part: AME Physical Examination Information and Disposition Tables

what_to_bring: A current, detailed Clinical Progress Note generated from a clinic visit with the treating gastroenterologist or surgeon no more than 90 days before the AME exam. It must include a detailed summary and discussion of the history of the condition; current medications, dosage, and side effects (if any); physical exam findings; results of any testing performed; diagnosis; assessment; plan (prognosis); and follow-up.
It must specifically include etiology, surgical outcomes, and any complications.
Other testing performed or deemed clinically necessary by the treating physician.
